summary.text: Tammy Townley is a Republican who was elected to Oklahoma House District 48 in 2018. Before her election she served as Deputy County Clerk in Carter County.

paragraphs.text: Townley previously supervised 13 counties and 108 trainees for a nonprofit helping provide jobs for senior citizens, and she spent 13 years on the Governor’s Workforce Council.
She also co-owned and managed The Living Word, a Bible bookstore in Ardmore, for over 22 years.
She graduated from Oklahoma State University with a degree in marketing and has one daughter.
